messages:
aj: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands — finance section had a lot packed in. A few quick Qs: 1) approval tiers for purchases, 2) how runway is modeled (do we assume hiring freeze?), 3) timing for spend-guardrails rollout.

maria: Great Qs. Short answers: 1) approval tiers will be tightened for Q3 — see matrix below. 2) runway shown in deck assumes current hiring plan + 10% buffer; i'll attach the model. 3) guardrails rollout planned mid-May, gradual enable by cost center.

lin: Adding procurement detail: we'll require cost-center tags and vendor categorization for any PO > $5k. Vendors without SOC2 will need legal review. Will post SOP in #finance-docs.

aj: Thanks — for approval tiers, is there a simple matrix we can follow? e.g., who approves $5k, $50k, $250k?

maria: Yep — roughly:
- < $2k: manager
- $2k–$25k: director + finance ack
- $25k–$150k: VP + finance
- > $150k: exec + procurement/legal

maria: Also sharing a short checklist: tag cost center, provide GL code, expected monthly spend, renewal date if SaaS, SOC2 status.

kira: P-cards — any change to card limits for managers? we get random one-off charges from new hires.

maria: P-card limits unchanged for now. Temporary exception path: managers can request a one-off increase via the procurement form (link). We'll audit monthly.

aj: On enforcement — will the system auto-block spend that isn't tagged or exceeds limits?

lin: We can enable hard blocks for untagged charges starting with new vendors, but recommend soft-blocks first so teams can adjust. Example rule we'll test:
```
if amount > 5000 and vendor.soc2 == false:
  hold_until_legal
elif cost_center == null:
  notify_and_hold
```

maria: We'll run a pilot on one Eng pod in May. If pilot looks good, full roll by end of June.

sam: Thanks team — appreciate the clarity. Heads up: execs ok with runway assumptions but asked to keep hiring reprioritization flexible if ARR slows.

procure-bot: Submitted: procurement-sop-draft v1 to /internal/finance/docs (link)

sync-bot: Reminder: finance follow-up meeting scheduled 2026-05-10 10:00am PT. Agenda: pilot scope, approval matrix, p-card audit.

aj: Perfect, i'll collect a list of outstanding vendor subscriptions and share before the meeting.

maria: Thanks. If anyone wants to review the model early, ping me and i'll share the sheet.
